name: Crunchy Black
notes: The research says two things plainly and this model is built out of both: his records sit at the **top of the lane's energy** and are built for the buck/jook dance function, so **the drum layer is the arrangement**. That is why this is the loudest and busiest kit in the batch — `velocityTiers` lift, the kick runs three or four a bar with high syncopation, the 16th cowbell layer is at 5–8 hits a bar at 0 dB, and the snare roll is the densest here (`gapProb` 0.06). Everything above the drums is deliberately thin: the research calls the melodic layer a **single ostinato synth line, often 1 bar**, so `phraseBars` weights 1 over 2, `monophonicBias` is 1 and `motifPitchCount` tops out at 4. Harmony is one chord and the research says outright it is irrelevant to his parameter set — "the value is rhythmic" — so `impliedByRiff` carries it and the chord part varies by duration rather than by root. The arrangement is his: 8-bar hook / 8-bar verse alternation with shorter verses than the rest of the group, call-and-response with the posse, and a drop-out to claps-plus-chant, hence `sectionBars.verse` 8 and `dropOutBeats.prob` 0.8. ⚠ `low`: the research rates it medium-low and states **all beat parameters are inherited from the crunk-era Hypnotize board** — `session.bpm` (74–84 half-time = 148–168 straight, marked [LOW-CONF]) and the specific kick/snare placements are the inferred ones. The group era, the Oscar credit and the dance function are what is sourced. ⚠ The bass ceiling came down from 40 to 39 so it stays under a chord part that starts at 40 — `coherence.rs` requires the highest bass note to sit at or below the lowest chord note, and this model overlapped by 1. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 943 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
